summary: Run at most one automatic heal rebuild at a time

replay.detail: No new replay trigger. A heal reserves the single full rebuild before it waits for the writer, so a concurrent peer gets replayed=false at once instead of queueing a second rebuild. The replay backoff starts when the rebuild finishes. One admitted rebuild still holds the writer for its whole length.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers or schema version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, admission, retention or drop-rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Heal answers keep their shape; a refused replay is the same replayed=false a peer already receives during the backoff. Mixed builds heal as before.

manual.detail: No data repair or configuration change.

recovery.detail: A refused peer retries its heal on its normal schedule. Each finished replay logs writer_wait_ms, writer_hold_ms and its outcome to stderr.
